title: fix(runtime): a refused action write answers with the localized message, not "ValidationError: …"
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuQVQdf3PvoJbKFFCUA4gwJB)_

Fixes #37533

## What changes

- `packages/runtime/src/sandbox/quickjs-runner.ts`: a new `refusalSentence(sentence, info)` on the path that builds a body's `SandboxError.innerMessage`, the sentence every door serves.
  - It applies only when the rejection carried `code` or `fields` (`__errorInfo`). There it drops a leading `<Name>Error: `, unless `isNativeErrorName` says the name is a native constructor's.
  - A record `ValidationError` a host write rejected with now reaches the `/actions` envelope's `error.message` as the localized message alone.
  - The nested-refusal relay (#22588) and the fault branch (#4431) are untouched.
- Unchanged: `SandboxError.message`, the log line, still reads `action 'x' threw: ValidationError: …`. `error.code` (`VALIDATION_FAILED`) and `error.details.fields` are unchanged too.
- Pins that asserted the class prefix now assert the message alone:
  - `error-passthrough.test.ts` (real runner, `innerMessage`)
  - `actions-validation-envelope.test.ts` (fixture and the toast-text assertion)
  - `actions-fault-vs-rejection.test.ts` (fixture)
  - Editing the last two brought them under `check:test-source-alias`, so they gain its module-top `import '@objectstack/metadata'`.
- A new pin, `actions-refused-write-sentence-37533.test.ts`, and a changeset (`@objectstack/runtime` patch).

## Why

When a field validation refuses a write a script action made, the toast showed `ValidationError: 时长（分钟）的小数位数不能超过 0 位(当前 1 位)`. This was measured on 18.6.0 in a zh-CN console (HotCRM, Log a Call). A form save of the same refusal shows the message alone. The sandbox's reject handler flattens a throw to `<name>: <message>`, and `userFacingMessage` only ever dropped a default `Error: `.

## Verification

- New pin, driving the real QuickJS runner into the real `/actions` door:
  - A refused write answers 400 with `error.message` equal to the localized message. `error.code` is `VALIDATION_FAILED` and `details.fields` is intact. The log line still names `ValidationError`.
  - A body that catches and re-throws the refusal answers the same.
  - CONTROLS: a crash keeps `TypeError: …` and answers 500. An uncoded `QuotaError` keeps its name. A plain `Error`'s message is the sentence, as before.
- On `main`'s runner, the first two cases fail and the three controls pass. With the fix, all five pass.
- `vitest run src/sandbox src/domains/action*` in `packages/runtime`: 64 files, 798 passed, 2 skipped.
- Also: `eslint` is clean on the changed source, `tsc --noEmit` passes for `packages/runtime`, `check-test-source-alias` is OK, and `overlap-check` is clean against `origin/main`.

## Small decisions

- Only a coded throw (`code` or `fields`) loses its class name. An uncoded custom class keeps it, as before, because the card's ask is the validation refusal and nothing tells an uncoded class from a bug.
- Only a name ending in `Error` is dropped, and never a native one, so the crash classification that reads `innerMessage` (`isNativeErrorName`, #17273) sees the same text as before.
- The fix sits in the sandbox, not in the `/actions` door, so a hook's coded refusal on `/data` (which reads the same `innerMessage`) shows the same sentence.
- The client and console mock fixtures that still carry `ValidationError: …` (`packages/client/src/actions-surface.test.ts`, `ui/packages/core/src/actions/__tests__/actionResponse.test.ts`) test pass-through of whatever text the door sends, so they are left as they are.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## Owed

- L1 (seat). Size XS, with no L2 owed by size or path.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (not touched)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
